references.text: Ezekiel speaks of blotting out the memory of a people who have sinned against God, reflecting the threat in Deuteronomy to let a people's name perish
The psalmist speaks of enemies whose memory is blotted out forever, connecting to the theme of erasing a people's memory
The Lord blots out the memory of the wicked from the earth, a theme that corresponds with the threat to make Israel's name vanish
Job describes how the memory of the ungodly fades from the earth, reflecting the idea of blotting out a people's memory
Proverbs speaks of how the memory of the righteous is blessed while the name of the wicked rots, contrasting with the threat to erase a memory
Isaiah describes how the Lord has blotted out the memory of oppressors, a theme related to erasing a people's memory
